verdict: Leg 2, re-armed and scoped to the fold 369303a0..e80fdaea (the notice's emission shape, mmnto-ai/totem#2879): 0 BLOCKING, 2 MATERIAL, 9 MINOR. The code path is converged: oneLine is a pure extraction and bounded is byte-identical at every caller; no sink downstream truncates a notice (the CLI passes stderr through, the hook wrapper re-emits it verbatim); the per-name arithmetic is exact and the notice count equals the collapsed-name count in every fixture; the three first-fold fixtures kill the three mutants the first leg named; the rerun reconstruction, the ordering specimen, the five-name head and the five-run name were all re-derived live as true; four hand-recomputed receipts match. What it found: r2-F1 never-sliced was unpinned, the fixture's longest fragment 32 chars against a 160 bound (folded: a fixture whose name exceeds the bound, asserted whole with no ellipsis); r2-F2 the README's universal fidelity sentence was falsified by synthetic-check-duplicate-id-missing (folded: that fixture's state FAILURE and the sentence scoped to synthetic-check-*); r2-F3 the spec miscounted the tests (folded); r2-F4 the unnamed-check pass-through keyed on the placeholder text with zero coverage (folded: a named flag on CheckEntry and a fixture with two unnamed runs); r2-F5 the SupersededRun interface orphaned judgeLatestRuns's JSDoc (folded: moved above it); r2-F6 the README instants enumeration omitted the 2879 rows (folded); r2-F7 the lone-null-id fixture pinned only the success direction (folded: a FAILURE null-id run beside it, deny asserted); r2-F8 the residual's workflow denominator omitted the four dynamic workflows (folded); r2-F9 31-of-31 was ambiguous with a live in-window counterexample for full order (folded: the spec pins the max element and names 9ce020bb); r2-F10 the changeset's sentence argued a major under a minor bump (folded: the sentence states why it is additive at every reader; minor ruled); r2-F11 the sanitiser's doc over-claimed C1 controls (folded: doc).
